title: Prompt Injection & Jailbreaks — Assume Detection Will Miss Some Attacks
key_insight: Combine detection with architectural controls: scoped data, output filtering, isolated execution, quotas, and audit logs.
body:
## Assume Detection Will Miss Some Attacks

A detector catches known phrases but attackers reword them. Blocking by keywords becomes an endless chase.

Combine detection with architectural controls: scoped data, output filtering, isolated execution, quotas, and audit logs.

Test indirect injection through documents, emails, tool results, and images. Track the complete path from content to possible side effect.
common_mistakes: A confident model request proves authorization.
Retrieved documents should be allowed to grant permissions.
mini_exercise: Draw “Assume Detection Will Miss Some Attacks” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Applications must treat model-readable content as untrusted because text can attempt to redirect instructions and tools.
